role.zh: Anthropic 联合创始人兼总裁

why.en: Runs Anthropic's business, financing and policy, and turned a safety research organisation into a sustainable commercial entity. As the IPO approaches, Dario has delegated operations to her almost entirely.
why.zh: 负责 Anthropic 的经营、融资与政策事务，把一个安全研究组织变成可持续的商业实体。随着 IPO 临近，Dario 已几乎将运营全权交予她。

title.en: On the pros and cons of an AI startup IPO
title.zh: 关于 AI 创业公司上市的利与弊

note.en: Argues that training frontier models is capital-intensive enough to make public markets a structural necessity.
note.zh: 主张训练前沿模型的资本密集度已高到使公开市场成为结构性必需。

title.en: Daniela Amodei Says Curiosity Is Underrated
title.zh: Daniela Amodei Says Curiosity Is Underrated

note.en: A Stanford GSB interview on running Anthropic as a self-described generalist, and how a non-technical background became an asset in leading an AI company.
note.zh: 斯坦福商学院的访谈，谈她以自认的“通才”身份管理 Anthropic，以及非技术背景如何成为领导一家 AI 公司的优势。

title.en: Anthropic President Daniela Amodei Talks the Future of Claude
title.zh: Anthropic President Daniela Amodei Talks the Future of Claude

note.en: A Bloomberg interview on Claude's model roadmap, Anthropic's commercialisation strategy and its dealings with the US government.
note.zh: 彭博访谈，谈 Claude 的模型路线、Anthropic 的商业化策略以及公司与美国政府的关系。

title.en: The Co-Founders of Claude AI Tell Oprah About the Impact Artificial Intelligence Has on Your Life
title.zh: The Co-Founders of Claude AI Tell Oprah About the Impact Artificial Intelligence Has on Your Life

note.en: She and Dario appear together on Oprah's podcast to explain what AI will mean for ordinary life — Anthropic's furthest reach into a mainstream audience.
note.zh: 她与 Dario 一同做客奥普拉的播客，向大众解释 AI 将如何影响日常生活，是 Anthropic 触及主流受众最远的一次。

title.en: A Conversation with Daniela Amodei, Co-Founder and President of Anthropic
title.zh: A Conversation with Daniela Amodei, Co-Founder and President of Anthropic

posts.source: It's Not Magic, a Sixth Street podcast

note.en: An interview on building Anthropic as a public benefit corporation and what that structure means for how the company is run.
note.zh: 访谈围绕以公益公司（PBC）形式创办 Anthropic，以及这一架构对公司运营方式的影响。

title.en: Building the Anthropic Team: Daniela Amodei on Hiring 10x AI Engineers | Frameworks for Growth
title.zh: Building the Anthropic Team: Daniela Amodei on Hiring 10x AI Engineers | Frameworks for Growth

note.en: Podcast interview in which she describes how Anthropic hires and builds its engineering team.
note.zh: 播客访谈，她讲述 Anthropic 如何招人、如何搭建工程团队。

title.en: Daniela Amodei (Anthropic) - ‘Helpful, Honest, Harmless’ AI
title.zh: Daniela Amodei (Anthropic) - ‘Helpful, Honest, Harmless’ AI

note.en: A Stanford ETL talk on Anthropic's "helpful, honest, harmless" framing and how she builds and manages the company's leadership team.
note.zh: 斯坦福 ETL 讲座，讲述 Anthropic “有用、诚实、无害” 的理念，以及她如何组建和管理公司的领导团队。

title.en: ‘Helpful, Honest, Harmless’ AI [Entire Talk]
title.zh: ‘Helpful, Honest, Harmless’ AI [Entire Talk]

note.en: Daniela Amodei discusses Anthropic's 'helpful, honest, harmless' safety philosophy and her role managing the company's leadership team, in an extended talk for Stanford's Entrepreneurial Thought Leaders series.
note.zh: 戴妮拉·阿莫代在斯坦福“创业思想领袖”系列的长篇访谈中，阐述了Anthropic“有用、诚实、无害”的安全理念，以及她管理公司领导团队的角色。

title.en: #177 President & Co-Founder Anthropic, Daniela Amodei: AI Hurricane
title.zh: #177 President & Co-Founder Anthropic, Daniela Amodei: AI Hurricane

note.en: A long-form interview on scaling Anthropic through its rapid funding growth and on operating a safety-first lab in a competitive market.
note.zh: 长篇访谈，谈 Anthropic 在快速融资增长中的扩张，以及如何在激烈竞争中经营一家以安全为先的实验室。

title.en: First Block: Interview with Daniela Amodei, Co-founder of Anthropic
title.zh: First Block: Interview with Daniela Amodei, Co-founder of Anthropic

note.en: An interview on the early years of Anthropic and the decisions made while the company was still finding its footing.
note.zh: 访谈回顾 Anthropic 的早期岁月，以及公司尚未站稳脚跟时所做的那些决定。

title.en: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations
title.zh: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations

note.en: Co-authored 'Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations,' an early Anthropic paper on using LMs to generate their own evaluation datasets.
note.zh: 合著《用模型生成评估发现语言模型行为》，这是Anthropic早期论文，探讨用语言模型自动生成评估数据集的方法。

title.en: Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models
title.zh: Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models

note.en: Co-authored 'Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models,' an early Anthropic paper on supervising models that may outperform humans.
note.zh: 合著《衡量大语言模型可扩展监督的进展》，这是Anthropic早期论文，探讨如何监督可能在多数技能上超越人类的模型。

title.en: Excited to announce our latest fundraising round! We’re genuinely honored to be entrusted with the resources to continue our work in frontier AI safety and rese
title.zh: Excited to announce our latest fundraising round! We’re genuinely honored to be entrusted with the resources to continue our work in frontier AI safety and rese

note.en: Amodei announced Anthropic's early fundraising round, framing it as continued backing for the company's frontier AI safety research.
note.zh: Amodei宣布Anthropic完成早期融资,称这将继续支持公司在前沿AI安全研究上的工作。

title.en: Daniela and Dario Amodei on Anthropic
title.zh: Daniela and Dario Amodei on Anthropic

note.en: She and Dario set out Anthropic's founding case for reliable, interpretable and steerable AI systems shortly after the company launched.
note.zh: 公司成立不久后，她与哥哥 Dario 共同阐述 Anthropic 的创立主张：构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI 系统。

title.en: Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models
title.zh: Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models

note.en: Co-authored 'Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models,' examining how large-scale pretraining produces both predictable and surprising capabilities.
note.zh: 合著《大型生成模型中的可预测性与意外性》，探讨大规模预训练如何同时产生可预测和令人意外的能力。

title.en: Defends the IPO push as revenue hits a $47B run rate
title.zh: 在营收达 470 亿美元年化时为 IPO 辩护

body.en: Up from roughly $9B at the end of 2025.
body.zh: 较 2025 年底约 90 亿美元大幅增长。

title.en: Dario and Daniela Amodei: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026
title.zh: Dario and Daniela Amodei: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026

body.en: TIME named her alongside Dario Amodei to its 2026 list of the 100 most influential people in AI.
body.zh: 《时代》周刊将她与 Dario Amodei 一同列入 2026 年 AI 领域 100 位最具影响力人物榜单。

title.en: Could AI face social media-style bans? Anthropic President Daniela Amodei reveals: ‘If we project some of challenges…’
title.zh: Could AI face social media-style bans? Anthropic President Daniela Amodei reveals: ‘If we project some of challenges…’

body.en: She warned that AI products could face social-media-style bans if the industry mishandles its risks, a policy stance from the executive who runs Anthropic's policy work.
body.zh: 她警告称，若行业未能妥善应对风险，AI 产品可能面临类似社交媒体的封禁；这是主管 Anthropic 政策事务的高管所表达的政策立场。

title.en: Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei Charts Leaner A.I. Strategy as IPO Race With OpenAI Heats
title.zh: Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei Charts Leaner A.I. Strategy as IPO Race With OpenAI Heats

body.en: Amodei sets out a leaner operating strategy for Anthropic as the company moves toward an IPO in parallel with OpenAI.
body.zh: 在与 OpenAI 并行推进 IPO 的节点上，Amodei 为 Anthropic 定下更精简的经营策略。

title.en: Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei shrugs off doubts about AI’s returns
title.zh: Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei shrugs off doubts about AI’s returns

body.en: Ahead of Anthropic's IPO she publicly pushed back on doubts about the returns on AI spending, defending the economics of the business she runs.
body.zh: 在 Anthropic 上市前夕，她公开回应外界对 AI 投入回报的质疑，为自己主管的业务经济模型辩护。

title.en: Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei shrugs off doubts about AI’s returns
title.zh: Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei shrugs off doubts about AI’s returns

body.en: Ahead of Anthropic's IPO, Daniela Amodei publicly dismissed doubts about whether AI investment will pay off.
body.zh: 在Anthropic首次公开募股前夕,达妮埃拉·阿莫迪公开驳斥了外界对AI投资回报的质疑。
